note_on_difficulty: Difficulty, a run of washes, a closed axis, a small expected gain, and a shortage of remaining hours are NOT blockers. They are the normal state of this problem. When every listed axis closes, the required response is to open a new one and name its first bounded experiment, not to report that the search is exhausted. A large idea is not deferred because it is large; it is decomposed until its first step fits the time available, and that step is run.
